evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 4.9 ppm after remaining near 3–6 ppm during the ramp.
Growth-stage oxygen rose to 20.3 ppm, following 6.7 and 13.4 ppm at 2520 and 2640 s.
Oxygen continued rising through 25.9 ppm at 2880 s to 33.3 ppm despite constant argon setpoint.
Temperature 750.1 °C and argon 100.5 sccm track setpoints; pressure remains near atmospheric at 760.6 Torr and status is running, so these channels do not explain the oxygen rise.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen verification and leak-integrity/inlet-gas checks are needed to distinguish air ingress from gas contamination, outgassing, or sensor error; sample characterization is not yet available.
